ABOUT NEO SCHOOL INDIA

Every Child is Unique.

Neo School India is a modern early-learning ecosystem created to make joyful, structured and developmentally appropriate learning accessible across communities.

OUR VISION

Quality Early Learning, Closer to Every Child.

To make high-quality, joyful and future-ready early education accessible to every child, including children in rural and emerging communities, through a modern, structured and child-centred learning ecosystem.

OUR MISSION

Learning That Connects and Grows.

Through IMLS — Integrated Modern Learning System, Neo connects knowledge, experience, communication and whole-child development while supporting strong foundations in language, phonics, early numeracy, motor development, social-emotional growth and practical life skills.

LEADERSHIP

Built from Experience. Driven by Purpose.

Leadership focused on meaningful early education, teacher development and stronger learning opportunities for children.

FOUNDER PROFILE

Umakanth Gilla

FOUNDER & DIRECTOR • NEO SCHOOL INDIA

With over 13 years of experience in pre-primary and primary education, Umakanth Gilla has worked across academic development, teacher training, school leadership and institutional management.

He holds an M.Com in Computers and has undergone training in Phonics and ECC. His educational journey includes recognition such as Best Creative Centre in the South Region.

13+ YearsAcademic DevelopmentTeacher TrainingPhonics & ECC

Neo School India was founded to help bridge the quality education gap between major urban markets and rural, semi-urban and emerging communities.
